errorHelp.blocked: Content from other files or the web is not loaded in this spreadsheet until you allow it in the notice above the sheet.
errorHelp.busy: Waiting for an answer (AI or another slow source); the cell fills in when it arrives.
errorHelp.calc: The calculation produced something a cell cannot show, such as an uncalled LAMBDA or an empty array.
errorHelp.cycle: Circular reference: this formula depends on its own result.
errorHelp.div0: Division by zero: a divisor is zero or an empty cell.
errorHelp.error: The formula could not be parsed. Check parentheses, commas, and quotes.
errorHelp.na: No match was found (lookup functions), or a value is not available.
errorHelp.name: Unknown function or name. Check the spelling, or quote text.
errorHelp.num: A number is out of range or a calculation did not converge.
errorHelp.ref: A reference points at cells or a sheet that no longer exist.
errorHelp.spill: The array result cannot fit here. Clear blocking cells, move the formula away from the sheet edge, or reduce the result size.
errorHelp.value: Wrong kind of value: text where a number was expected, or an array where one value was.
